description: Fixed the critical scalar parameter initialization bug in the GPT class where `y` and `x0_lambdas` were incorrectly assigned to class variables (`self.y`, `self.x0`) instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`) during the forward pass, causing the MuonAdamW optimizer to fail initialization on the first step due to passing uninitialized tensors to the `Block` class. This restored the model to a stable val_bpb of 0.9913.
